No fishing hooks, no lines, no rocks, no bubbles, no labels. Subject: カワヨシノボリ, Rhinogobius flumineus, a tiny Japanese freshwater river goby, NOT a marine mahaze. Short stocky elongated body with broad blunt slightly flattened head and eyes high on head, small mouth, large rounded fan pectoral fins, two separate low rounded dorsal fins, a rounded tail NOT forked. Olive tan to sandy brown back, pale cream underside, a row of seven to ten subtle dark blotches down flanks, fine small dark speckles on cheeks, small crescent marks at the base of pectoral fins. Plausible real goby proportions, body about4times maximum depth. Upper jaw and lip clearly drawn at the visible snout for hook anchoring. Show tiny pelvic sucker where perspective permits. Avoid long whiskers, spines on cheeks, huge trout mouth, marine yellow-orange coloration. Transparent blank space everywhere outside these eight fish.

edits.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this original transparent eight-pose RPG Kidako moray atlas. Correct only the swimming body posture so it fits a game sprite with a fixed lip anchor. No skewed, rotated, or sliced reused body; each view a complete independent anatomically coherent drawing. Keep mouth closed poses1-7, naturally open with pointed teeth in8.
